Multimedia Designer

Location: Balaclava, Melbourne, VIC (Full-time, Permanent)
Salary range: 75,000 - 85,000.

About TAG

TAG is a Melbourne-based full-service digital marketing agency partnering with businesses to drive growth through strategy, creative, paid media, websites, CRM and digital transformation. Our head office is located in Balaclava, Melbourne, where this full-time position is based.

We're seeking a talented Multimedia Designer to create engaging digital content across multiple platforms, helping our clients communicate effectively and achieve meaningful commercial outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

*Consult with clients and internal teams to determine creative objectives, audience requirements and project outcomes.
*Design and produce multimedia content including digital graphics, motion graphics, animations, video assets and interactive content.
*Develop creative concepts and visual solutions for digital campaigns, websites, social media and marketing initiatives.
*Create static and animated assets using industry-standard design and multimedia software.
*Collaborate with strategists, designers, developers and marketing specialists to deliver integrated creative solutions.
*Prepare production-ready artwork and oversee quality throughout the production process.
*Ensure all creative work aligns with client brand guidelines, technical specifications and campaign objectives.
*Contribute innovative ideas that improve user engagement, creative quality and campaign performance.
*Stay current with emerging multimedia technologies, creative trends and industry best practices.

Skills & Experience

*Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Multimedia Design, Graphic Design, Digital Media or a related discipline.
*Demonstrated experience producing multimedia content with a strong digital portfolio.
*Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including After Effects, Illustrator and Photoshop.
*Experience creating digital assets across websites, social media and online marketing campaigns.
*Strong creative, visual communication and problem-solving skills.
*Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and deadlines.

result.description: Mansys Pty Ltd   Software Developer   Mansys Pty Ltd is recruiting on behalf of Sonar Technologies International   Location:  Macquarie Park, NSW   Employment Type:  Full-time, Permanent   Salary:  $80,000–$90,000 plus superannuation, depending on skills and experience   About the Company   Sonar Technologies International is an Australian technology company specialising in enterprise mobility and smart business solutions.  Sonar develops and implements software products that automate operational workflows across transport and logistics, mobile workforce management, warehousing, field services, retail and healthcare. Its solutions provide capabilities such as job scheduling, dispatch management, route optimisation, real-time tracking, inventory management, reporting and integration with existing ERP and CRM platforms.   About the Role   The role will primarily involve C# and .NET application development, API integration, database-driven software solutions and the deployment of applications through modern cloud and container environments.   Key Responsibilities    Analyse business requirements, functional specifications and existing application workflows.  Develop, maintain and enhance software applications using C#, .NET and related technologies.  Design, develop and test APIs used to integrate Sonar applications with customer, ERP, CRM and third-party systems.  Write maintainable and appropriately documented program code in accordance with technical specifications and development standards.  Identify limitations and deficiencies in existing applications and recommend suitable software improvements.  Test, debug and correct application errors to ensure systems perform reliably and according to specification.  Assist in upgrading legacy .NET applications and APIs to current frameworks and development standards.  Develop and maintain database-driven functionality using SQL and relational database technologies.  Develop and maintain automated build, testing and deployment processes through CI/CD pipelines.  Assist with the deployment and operation of applications in cloud environments such as Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure or AWS.  Monitor application performance, investigate runtime issues and implement software-level fixes.  Develop internal utilities and automation tools using technologies such as Python, Go, PowerShell or Bash.  Prepare and maintain technical documentation, deployment instructions and operational procedures.  Work with software architects, developers, project teams and support personnel throughout the software development lifecycle.    Qualifications and Experience    Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering or a closely related discipline.  At least one year of relevant software development or closely related commercial experience.  Practical experience developing applications or APIs using C# and .NET.  Experience with REST APIs and system integration.  Familiarity with cloud platforms such as GCP, Azure or AWS.  Familiarity with CI/CD tools and source-control platforms such as Bitbucket or Git.    Desirable Skills    Experience modernising legacy .NET applications.  Experience developing software for logistics, workforce management, warehousing, healthcare or other operational environments.  Knowledge of real-time data processing, GPS, mobile applications, reporting systems or ERP/CRM integration.  Experience with Python, Go, PowerShell or Bash scripting.  Understanding of application monitoring tools and cloud-based observability  Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.         About Company    Mansys is an Australian recruitment service focused on tradespeople and other in-demand workers. It supports roles across trades, automotive, hospitality, care services, agriculture, and manufacturing. result.description:
Data Engineer
Trading under Publicis Communications
Location: Sydney or Melbourne or Brisbane

Data Engineer (also known as BI Developer, Quantitative Data Engineer, Search Engineer, Technical Architect, Big Data Analyst, Solutions Architect, Data Warehouse Engineer, Data Science Software Engineer, ETL Developer)
The role of the Data Engineer is to work alongside solution architects, data analysts & data scientists to deliver various aspects of the marketing technology ecosystem. The Data Engineer is responsible for engaging machine learning techniques to create and sustain structures that allow for the analysis of data whilst remaining familiar with dominant programming and deployment strategies. Data engineering experience is critical, as well as knowledge of data warehousing, ETL strategies and tools, and BI tools. Experience in cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS and GCP is beneficial.
Data Engineer Responsibilities:
•	Anticipating and mitigating delivery risks and following issues through to closure
•	Advocating for data management methodologies and processes on all projects
•	Assuming responsibility for data quality, ensuring that testing is carried out in a rigorous fashion resulting in production of high-quality deliverables
•	Adopting a flexible approach to completing workload to ensuring timely delivery and reinforcing commitment to delivery and quality within the technical team, including offshore development centres 
•	Creating and managing the relevant technical design documentation and ensures the documents completeness and accuracy
•	Ensuring that data architecture is implemented according to the design 
•	Ensuring solutions delivered use existing standards and frameworks
•	Contributing to business development efforts through accurate project scoping, estimating and attending sales calls when required
•	Collaborating with globally dispersed teams on international projects.  This includes co-ordinating build activities with offshore development centres in India and Asia Pacific
•	Remaining up-to-date with industry standards and technological advancements that will improve the quality of your outputs.
Data Engineer Requirements:
•	All of the above roles require a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.
•	Proven experience as a data engineer, software developer, or similar.
•	Expert proficiency in Python, C++, Java, R, and SQL.
•	Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
•	Works well independently but also a team player and able to work collaboratively
•	Scrupulous approach to duties.
•	Strong presentation and written communication skills, with ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical colleagues and clients
•	Experience developing data processing and analytics solutions in a digital agency or IT consultancy as part of a multi-disciplinary team
